correctness.rationale: The majority update flips x_i precisely if both incident walls are 1. XOR differentiation gives d_i’=d_i(1⊕d_{i-1}⊕d_{i+1}); zero walls persist while each bounded run of one-walls erodes by two from its ends, with an isolated 1 fixed. Thus first-fixed time is floor(q/2), q=max one-run length in a non-all-one wall word. Exactly the all-one wall state yields a nonfixed alternating temporal 2-cycle, possible only at even n and represented by exactly two x. A cyclic wall word comes from x iff its parity is even, with two preimages. A (L+1)-state transfer matrix counting cyclic one-runs bounded by L has det(I-zT)=Q_L(u,z); the trace/log determinant and parity projection yield the all-n,t cumulative rational GF. Edge cases n=1,2 are covered. Independent exhaustive synchronous evolution and coefficient enumeration checked n=1..14; all-n follows from wall and transfer proofs.
residual_risks: Finite simulations do not prove the all-length generating function; the transfer argument does.
